scope: Main executable level callback ownership, not a visual identification or proof of an audible effect.
registration: 0x800241F4 registers it in the level callback array when enable-mask bit 0x80 is set.
state: Pool pointer 0x800EE094; six groups, group stride 0x1E8; three elements per group with stride 0x9C.

random_sites.0x800284AC: rand()%3 during element phases 2/6; may copy another element coordinate target.
random_sites.0x80028670: Random byte used when an element changes phase.

pause_condition: Branch skips update work for submode 1, not submode 2.
limits: Callback draws share the same 0x800F3994 state as soldier initialization, attacks and collision decisions.
Enable-mask/register layout is code-backed; changing settings/turning the system off has not been tested.
